description: AI-powered deep research tool. Breaks your question into sub-queries, runs multiple Google searches, then synthesizes a cited research report using your LLM (OpenRouter or Gemini). Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.

country.description: Country code for search localisation. Default: "US".

depth.description: Research depth: "basic" (3 sub-queries, fast), "standard" (5 sub-queries, balanced), "deep" (8 sub-queries, exhaustive). Default: "standard".

query.description: Research question or topic to investigate.

name: deep_research
